changes.name: Dada DiCapo
changes.before: Vincent, you remember the work before anybody cared who made it. Donor Collapse: an empty dinner jacket falls off a gilded chair. changes.name: Dada DiCapo
changes.before: Vincent, you remember the work before anybody took it seriously. Donor Collapse: an empty jacket falls off a gilded chair. I made the film; Grant's foundation wanted to acquire it with my name removed. Then I was supposed to thank him. He wasn't going to enjoy the version he bought.
changes.after: His foundation would acquire Donor Collapse, my name would come off it, and I was supposed to thank him. An empty dinner jacket falls off a gilded chair. I made that film. changes.name: Dada DiCapo
changes.before: She said no again. I went into the private room to find the coordinator, showed her the falling-jacket film on my phone, and tried to restore the canceled cue. Grant's place was set. changes.name: Dada DiCapo

changes.name: Dada DiCapo
changes.before: Don't soften it, Vincent. I wanted him alive in that chair, furious, with everyone laughing. The film shows an empty jacket falling. Grant rejected it; I kept pushing. That was the whole spiteful idea. You don't have to find a kind version for me.
changes.after: Alive. Furious. Sitting in that chair while everyone laughed. That's what I wanted for Grant. The film shows an empty jacket falling. He rejected it and I kept pushing. Leave the spite in it, Vincent. You don't have to find a kind version for me.

changes.name: Dada DiCapo
changes.before: He was supposed to get up. Grant agreed to the private live version after the toast; he canceled the public program. Of course I took a little from the bottle for Donor Collapse. I thought it was inert. I wasn't rehearsing by his glass. He was supposed to get up.
changes.after: He was supposed to get up. Grant agreed to the private live version after the toast; he only canceled the public program. I took a little from the bottle for Donor Collapse. changes.name: Sue Venir
changes.before: Mona, sit down before I have to catch you. My markup allowed hospitality. The manager poured the punch in Grant's room while I was there. changes.after: The manager poured the punch in Grant's room while I was there. That was my only visit. I lifted the glass to get his agreement out from under it, and stayed while it was filled. My public markup allowed hospitality. Mona, sit down before I have to catch you.

changes.name: Barb Dwyer
changes.before: Did he ask security for an exception? Yes. Privacy from the live monitor. I agreed. Artie wanted a smooth evening; I wanted visiting crews out of our way. People tell me to stop being suspicious, then ask why I didn't suspect something. Grant got his exception. I knew who would get the questions afterwards.
changes.after: Grant requested privacy from the live monitor. I agreed. Artie wanted a smooth evening; I wanted visiting crews out of our way. Security gets the questions after the donor gets his exception. I knew that. I'm asked to be less suspicious here, then asked why I didn't suspect something. I gave him the exception anyway.

changes.name: Barb Dwyer
changes.before: Did he ask security for an exception? Yes. I took his room off the live monitor and logged an equipment fault. He knew it was privacy. That gave him something to use next time I refused. Artie wanted a smooth evening. I wanted visiting crews out of our way. Grant liked having a security director who'd broken her own rule for him.
changes.after: I logged an equipment fault. Grant had asked for privacy from the live monitor, and I took his room off it. He knew perfectly well it was privacy. Next time I refused him something, he'd have that entry. Artie wanted the evening smooth. I wanted visiting crews out of our way. Grant liked having a security director who'd already broken her own rule for him.

changes.name: Barb Dwyer

When Grant wanted privacy, I cleared the room. Artie used it too. I wrote fault in the log. It was privacy. Paige wanted a record of what happened in there. I'd already made that impossible. I understood the difference when I wrote it.

changes.name: Barb Dwyer
changes.before: Brie, what do your staff need? Give me something to do. I took Grant's camera off the live monitor; outside crews stayed out, staff and caterers still needed access. changes.name: Barb Dwyer
changes.before: Check local storage before you call my visit unobserved. The room check, including the glass, is recorded there. The technician removed the network lead, not the power. I used fault in the log to give Grant privacy. Wrong, yes. The footage still exists. Check it.
